'''Needle Rats''' were predatory mammals found on the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], as well as [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They had the ability to turn into a ball and charge at enemies using its needled fur.
